## **6 Basislauf**

```{python}
model = build_model()
bptk = BPTK_Py.bptk()
bptk.register_model(model)

scenario_manager = {"sm_kaffrine": {"model": model, "base_constants": {}}}
bptk.register_scenario_manager(scenario_manager)
bptk.register_scenarios(scenario_manager="sm_kaffrine", scenarios={"basis": {}})

bptk.plot_scenarios(
    scenario_managers=["sm_kaffrine"],
    scenarios=["basis"],
    equations=["bevoelkerung", "abwanderung"],
)
```
